title: Young Man on a Terrace
story: Young Man on a Terrace, c. 1730, oil on canvas. The image displays a young person standing next to a large, ornate vase filled with colorful flowers.

title: The Battle of La Hogue
story: The Battle of La Hogue, 1778, oil on canvas. We hover low over a body of choppy water in front of several rowboats filled to capacity with light-skinned men jostling and fighting each other amid larger wooden ships in this horizontal painting of a naval battle. The water transitions from tan and pale green near us to sage green in the background.

title: Alsa Slade
story: Alsa Slade, 1816, oil on canvas. The image depicts a woman from the waist up, seated and holding a piece of lacework. She faces slightly to her right, with a direct gaze.

title: Niagara
story: Niagara, 1857, oil on canvas. We hover over the bottle-green surface of a river as it rushes toward a horseshoe-shaped waterfall that curves away from us in this horizontal landscape painting. The water is white and frothy right in front of us, where the shelf of the riverbed changes levels near the edge of the falls.

title: Nude Seated
story: Nude Seated, 1912, oil on canvas. A nude, pale-skinned woman sits facing away from us on a surface with bunches of blue and green-toned fabrics in this vertical painting. The woman’s right knee and torso angle away from us to the right, but she turns her head a bit to our left so we see the underside of her chin.

title: The Death of Saint Clare
story: The Death of Saint Clare, c. 1400/1410, oil on panel. A dozen people surround a woman reclining in a bed in front of a gleaming gold background in this vertical painting.

title: The Cartographer Professor Josef Jüttner and His Wife
story: The Cartographer Professor Josef Jüttner and His Wife, 1824, oil on wood. This painting shows two people. A woman is leaning over a seated man from the left, with one arm around his shoulder and holding a basket of fruit in her other hand.

title: Baby (Cradle)
story: Baby (Cradle), 1917/1918, oil on canvas. A baby nestles in a mass of frilly white fabric atop a colorful patchwork, perhaps a pile of quilts, against a sage and spring-green background in this square painting. The baby’s face and right hand peeks out from the mountain of fabric at the top center of the composition.

title: View near Naples
story: View near Naples, c. 1806, oil on paper on canvas. Soft green hills carpeted with plants sweep away from us in the bottom third of this horizontal painting on paper.

title: Young Woman in White Holding a Bouquet
story: Young Woman in White Holding a Bouquet, c. 1865/1875, oil on wood. The artwork depicts a young woman shown from the waist up.

title: Portrait of a Lady
story: Portrait of a Lady, c. 1730/1750, oil on canvas. The image displays a portrait of a woman with fair complexion, featuring a distinctive nose and a subtle smile.

title: The Lavie Children
story: The Lavie Children, c. 1770, oil on canvas. Three young boys, four girls, and a dark brown dog gather in a loose semi-circle in a grassy clearing near a grove of trees in this horizontal landscape painting.

title: Wivenhoe Park, Essex
story: Wivenhoe Park, Essex, 1816, oil on canvas. We look out onto a landscape with low, grassy hills to the left, a lake to the right, and a brick building in the center distance below a sky filled with towering white clouds in this horizontal painting. A wooden fence closer to us crosses the landscape from the lower left corner and disappears where the land slopes down to meet the water at the center of the painting.

title: Grapes Against White Wall
story: Grapes Against White Wall, 1883, oil on canvas. This painting shows a cluster of grapes hanging from a vine with green leaves and thin tendrils which appear to loop around a gray nail at the top of the painting. The grapes are mostly painted in deep reds and purples, although some are pale yellow.

title: Andrew W. Mellon
story: Andrew W. Mellon, 1932, oil and gouache on hardboard. The artwork is a portrait showing the head and shoulders of an older man in profile, facing left.

title: Madonna and Child on a Curved Throne
story: Madonna and Child on a Curved Throne, c. 1260/1280, tempera on linden panel. A woman and child sit on an ornate gold, curving throne in front of a shimmering gold background in this vertical painting.

title: His First Appearance in Public
story: His First Appearance in Public, 1870, oil on wood. This painting shows a group of children in the woods. To the left of center, a boy plays the violin, standing on the edge of a gray path.

title: Procession by a Lake
story: Procession by a Lake, 19th century, oil on fabric. This painting shows a waterfront viewed from high above. In the background, light blue hills obscure the horizon line.

title: View of the Cloaca Maxima, Rome
story: View of the Cloaca Maxima, Rome, 1814, oil on canvas. A person, tiny in scale, walks along a path between two grassy mounds that lead back to a band of brown buildings that span the width of this horizontal landscape painting. The grassy mounds are covered with frosty and spring green growth, with a few patches of ivory-white dirt.

title: Bearded Man with a Beret
story: Bearded Man with a Beret, c. 1630, oil on panel. Shown from the shoulders up, a bearded man with wrinkles lining his pale-skinned face looks up and to our left, toward a bright light source, in this vertical portrait painting.

title: An English Warship Firing a Salute
artist: Willem van de Velde the Younger
story: An English Warship Firing a Salute, 1673, oil on canvas. A three-masted warship against a sky piled with clouds fills most of the right half of this vertical painting. The cream-white sails are bright in the sunlight, and tiny deckhands work along the horizontal yards and along the rigging.

title: Flowers in a Vase
story: Flowers in a Vase, c. 1700, oil on canvas. A profusion of flowers mostly in ruby red, bright white, and flamingo pink are gathered in a bronze-colored urn, set on a stone ledge against a dark background in this vertical still life painting.

title: Amsterdam Street Scene
story: Amsterdam Street Scene, , oil on wood. This painting shows a cobblestone street lined on both sides by buildings and tall green trees. A building with a red-tiled roof and stone walls is visible on the right, partly covered by tree branches.

title: Green Wheat Fields, Auvers
story: Green Wheat Fields, Auvers, 1890, oil on canvas. Verdant green fields roll in undulating waves back alongside a road in this horizontal landscape painting. The fields take up the left and center of the composition and are painted with thick, curling strokes of emerald, pea, and celery green, and corn yellow to suggest grasses and plants.

title: Portrait of a Woman
story: Portrait of a Woman, 2nd century, encaustic on wood. This painting shows the upper body of a person, focusing on their face and shoulders. The person is facing forward, looking directly at us.

title: Anna Maria van Schurman
story: Anna Maria van Schurman, 1657, oil on panel. Shown from the waist up, a woman looks at us steadily from behind an oval opening in this vertical portrait, which is painted entirely in tones of sepia and golden brown. The woman’s shoulders and face are angled to our left, but she looks at us with large, dark eyes.

title: Portrait of a Lady
story: Portrait of a Lady, c. 1715/1730, perhaps close to 1725, oil on canvas. The image shows a woman seated, angled slightly to the left, with her right arm resting on a surface and her left hand on her lap.

title: Portrait of a Man
story: Portrait of a Man, c. 1770, oil on canvas. The image shows the upper half of a man's body.

title: The Judgment of Paris
story: The Judgment of Paris, late 16th century, oil on canvas. Three nude women, three men, and a child stand or sit under the canopies of trees close to us as others move through a deep mountainous landscape in this horizontal painting. The people all have pale skin and muscular proportions.

title: Queen Henrietta Maria with Sir Jeffrey Hudson
story: Queen Henrietta Maria with Sir Jeffrey Hudson, 1633, oil on canvas. A woman with pale skin, wearing a shimmering, azure-blue gown, stands next to a child with a pale pink complexion, wearing a flame-red suit in this vertical portrait painting. The woman stands at the center of the composition with her body angled to our left, but she looks at us from the corners of her brown eyes.

title: A Hanging Wall Pouch
story: A Hanging Wall Pouch, 1677, oil on panel, mirrored glass. The artwork depicts a hanging wall pouch filled with various objects. At the top, there are letters and rolled papers.

title: Anna de Peyster (?)
story: Anna de Peyster (?), 1731, oil on canvas. The image shows a woman from the waist up. She is turned slightly to her right, looking straight at the viewer.

title: Profile Portrait of a Lady
story: Profile Portrait of a Lady, c. 1410, oil on panel. Shown from the chest up on the far side of a narrow ledge, a woman wearing an elaborate headdress and gown faces our left in profile in this vertical portrait painting.

title: Episodes from the Life of a Bishop Saint
story: Episodes from the Life of a Bishop Saint, c. 1500, oil on panel. A bearded man kneels before a bishop in front of a crowd gathered outside a church in this vertical painting.

title: Still Life with Plums
story: Still Life with Plums, first half 17th century, oil on canvas. The image depicts a grouping of plums on a ceramic plate, an orange fruit on the left, a loaf of bread on the right, set on a wooden surface against a dark background. The plum colors and green leaves contrast with the orange fruit.

title: A Miracle of Saint Benedict
story: A Miracle of Saint Benedict, c. 1480, oil on oak. Two scenes showing monks wearing black hoods and robes take place on this vertical panel painting.

title: Portrait of a Man
story: Portrait of a Man, c. 1536/1540, oil on walnut. This painting shows a man from the waist up.

title: A Lady in Her Bath
story: A Lady in Her Bath, c. 1571, oil on oak. Red satin drapes are drawn back to either side of this vertical painting to reveal a nude woman with pale, white skin sitting upright in a narrow bathtub.

title: Still Life with Trophies of the Hunt
story: Still Life with Trophies of the Hunt, 17th century, oil on canvas. This painting shows an arrangement of dead birds and a rabbit on a wooden surface covered with a red cloth. The animals are upside down, with their heads hanging over the edge of the surface and their bodies piled atop one another.

title: Countess Ebba Sparre
story: Countess Ebba Sparre, 1652/1653, oil on canvas. Shown from the hips up, a woman with pale skin, wearing a sapphire-blue gown, looks over her left shoulder at us in this vertical portrait painting. Her body faces our left in profile, and she looks at us from the corners of her large, hooded, gray eyes.

title: Fête Champêtre
story: Fête Champêtre, c. 1730, oil on canvas. Six women, four men, two children, and a dog sit or stand in a loose line close to us in a misty forest setting in this horizontal landscape painting.

title: The Camera Obscura
story: The Camera Obscura, 1764, oil on canvas. A young woman and two children are shown from the waist up through an oval, stone opening, holding and looking at a wooden box with a lens protruding from one side in this square painting. All three people have pale skin with rosy cheeks.

title: A View near Volterra
story: A View near Volterra, 1838, oil on canvas. We look slightly down onto a man riding a white horse away from us on a dirt road winding through a sun-drenched, rocky landscape in this horizontal painting. The man wears a cobalt-blue jacket and soft black hat, and the rutted path he follows cuts along the side of a steep hill or mountain peak.

title: The Sisters
story: The Sisters, 1869, oil on canvas. Shown from the lap up, two women with pale skin and dark hair pulled up and back, wearing white dresses with baby-blue polka dots, sit on a couch in this horizontal portrait painting. Both women have straight, dark brows, delicate noses, smooth skin, and their small, rose-pink mouths are closed.

title: Waterloo Bridge, London, at Sunset
story: Waterloo Bridge, London, at Sunset, 1904, oil on canvas. We look across a river at a bridge that spans the center of this horizontal landscape, which is painted entirely with broad, visible brushstrokes in pastel colors. The straight deck of the bridge crosses the center of the composition but angles slightly away from us as it moves to our right.

title: Saint Apollonia Destroys a Pagan Idol
story: Saint Apollonia Destroys a Pagan Idol, c. 1442/1445, tempera on poplar panel. A woman climbs a ladder propped against a tall base of a white stone sculpture with a sledgehammer over one shoulder in this vertical, arched painting.

title: Lot and His Daughters [reverse]
story: Lot and His Daughters [reverse], c. 1496/1499, oil on panel. A man and two women walk on a dirt path through a verdant landscape, carrying packs, walking sticks, and other provisions, while in the distance fiery explosions spew flames and plumes of smoke sky-high in this horizontal painting.

title: Madonna and Child
story: Madonna and Child, probably c. 1535 or after, oil on panel. This painting shows the upper half of a woman and a standing infant.

title: The Crucifixion
story: The Crucifixion, c. 1550/1575, oil on panel. The artwork depicts a scene of the crucifixion, with a central figure on a cross, wearing a crown of thorns and a white cloth around the waist.

title: Still Life with Iris
story: Still Life with Iris, 1623, oil on copper. This painting shows a bouquet of various colorful flowers bursting out of a glass vase. A large, bright orange lily is at the center, surrounded by a variety of large and small flowers in red, white, blue, yellow, and pink, with a large blue iris in the top right corner.

title: Still Life with Fruit, Fish, and a Nest
story: Still Life with Fruit, Fish, and a Nest, c. 1675, oil on canvas. Fruit, flowers, birds, small animals, insects, and fish are piled in and set around a woven basket in woodland setting in this vertical still life painting.

title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
story: The Adoration of the Shepherds, c. 1764/1765, oil on canvas. Four men, a boy, an ox, and a donkey crowd around a young woman holding a baby inside a shadowy wooden structure in this vertical painting.

title: City Hall at Thorn
story: City Hall at Thorn, 1848, oil on canvas. This painting shows a large pink brick building with grand architecture. Above it, the sky is a blend of white and light blue hues with fluffy clouds.

title: White Beeches in Fall
story: White Beeches in Fall, 1910, oil on canvas. The painting depicts birch trees and autumn foliage. The composition is filled with white-gray tree trunks and colorful leaves.

title: The Holy Family with Saint Anne and the Infant John the Baptist
story: The Holy Family with Saint Anne and the Infant John the Baptist, c. 1595/1600, oil on canvas. A young woman sitting with a nude infant lying in her lap is flanked on either side by an older woman to our left and an elderly man with a nude young boy to our right in this vertical painting.

title: The Annunciation
story: The Annunciation, c. 1508/1519, oil on panel. A young woman sits wearing a voluminous, long, royal-blue dress to our right and a winged angel wearing a white robe stands looking at her with one arm raised to our left in this vertical painting.

title: Mrs. Charles S. Carstairs
story: Mrs. Charles S. Carstairs, 1914, oil on canvas.

title: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Four Saints
story: Madonna and Child Enthroned with Four Saints, c. 1240/1245, tempera on panel. A woman wearing a long black robe sits on a wide, bench-like seat and holds a child on her lap in this vertical painting.

title: Saint James Minor
story: Saint James Minor, c. 1272, tempera on panel. A bearded, light-skinned man is shown striding to our left and looking in that direction between two columns supporting an arch in this vertical painting.

title: The Baptism of Christ
story: The Baptism of Christ, c. 1335, tempera on panel. A nude man, Jesus, stands with hands together in prayer, hip-deep in a stylized river with a bearded man wearing a fur-like garment on a rocky bank to one side and two winged angels on the other, all against a gleaming gold background in this vertical painting.

title: Saint Andrew and Saint Benedict with the Archangel Gabriel [left panel]
story: Saint Andrew and Saint Benedict with the Archangel Gabriel [left panel], shortly before 1387, tempera on poplar panel. Two men with gray hair and beards stand under pointed arches with a winged angel in the triangular gable above, all against a gold background and set within a carved, gold frame in this vertical painting. This is the left wing of a three-panel triptych.

title: The Crippled and Sick Cured at the Tomb of Saint Nicholas
story: The Crippled and Sick Cured at the Tomb of Saint Nicholas, 1425, tempera on panel. A dozen men and women approach or gather around a stone tomb in a church in this square painting. The people all have pale skin and wear robes in muted blue, sage green, apricot, dark pink, or vivid red.

title: Madonna and Child
story: Madonna and Child, c. 1490, tempera on panel. A woman is shown from the waist up behind a ledge, on which a baby stands in front of a gold background in this vertical painting.

title: Cephalus and Pan at the Temple of Diana
story: Cephalus and Pan at the Temple of Diana, c. 1520/1522, fresco. This is a fresco of an elegant building with a garden and waterway in front of it.

title: Fantastic Landscape with Figures
story: Fantastic Landscape with Figures, late 16th century, oil on canvas. The painting shows a high vantage point of a group of people in a dark, green landscape. Closest to us, near the center of the painting, are the six people with pale white skin and long yellow hair, wearing in flowing garments in yellow, white, and blue.

title: The Ecstasy of the Magdalen
story: The Ecstasy of the Magdalen, 1616/1620, oil on canvas. A kneeling woman and two nude, winged, child-like angels supporting her all look up at three angels on a cloud bank in this vertical painting. The woman and her attendants in the lower right corner take up half the composition, which is divided from the second group by a diagonal line of charcoal-gray clouds.

title: A Man Cutting Tobacco
story: A Man Cutting Tobacco, 1660s, oil on canvas. A light-skinned, clean-shaven man sitting cross-legged on the floor nearly fills this almost square painting. His body is angled to our right, and he bends forward, using a knife to cut a block of dried tobacco leaves on a wood board.

title: Interior of the Pantheon, Rome
story: Interior of the Pantheon, Rome, c. 1734, oil on canvas. Dozens of men and women wander through a tall interior space lined with statues and columns and topped by a soaring domed roof in this vertical painting.

title: The Fortress of Königstein: Courtyard with the Magdalenenburg
story: The Fortress of Königstein: Courtyard with the Magdalenenburg, 1756-1758, oil on canvas. The painting depicts a stately building complex from an elevated point. The buildings are large, with white, ivy-covered walls and dark, peaked roofs.

title: After the Bath
story: After the Bath, after 1889, oil on wood. One person with brown skin lies on a patterned carpet and a nude woman, also with brown skin, stoops and holds a white cloth to her thighs in this loosely painted horizontal scene. A wall, painted with streaks and smudges of fog gray, white, and pale peach, spans the right two-thirds of the composition behind the people.

title: Nude on a Divan
story: Nude on a Divan, 1918, oil on canvas. A nude woman lying across a brown divan in front of a russet-red wall is loosely painted with areas of mottled color in this horizontal composition. The woman fills the wide canvas so her head is angled into the upper left corner, and her legs extend off the right edge of the composition below the knees.

title: Christ Gathering His Garments after the Flagellation
story: Christ Gathering His Garments after the Flagellation, c. 1670s, oil on canvas. This is a painting of a scene with a suffering man surrounded by five angels.

title: The Annunciation
story: The Annunciation, c. 1434/1436, oil on canvas transferred from panel. A woman and winged angel, both with pale, peach skin, are situated in a church interior in this tall, narrow painting.

title: Portrait of a Lady
story: Portrait of a Lady, c. 1460, oil on panel. A woman with pale white skin and her blond hair covered by a wide veil is shown from the waist up in this vertical portrait painting.

title: Portrait of a Man, possibly Jan Snoeck
story: Portrait of a Man, possibly Jan Snoeck, c. 1530, oil on panel. Shown from about the waist up behind a forest-green desktop, a man with smooth, pale pink skin writes in an open book with a quill pen as he looks at us, surrounded closely by papers, pens and ink, and other objects in this vertical portrait painting.

title: Portrait of a Gentleman
story: Portrait of a Gentleman, 1569, oil on canvas. Shown from the thighs up against a dark background, a man with light skin, wearing a black satin jerkin with puffed breeches, stands with his hand on the neck of a dog by his side in this vertical portrait painting. The man stands with his body angled to our right but looks at us from the corners of his dark eyes.

title: View from Vaekero near Christiania
story: View from Vaekero near Christiania, 1827, oil on canvas. A man and woman stand look away from us toward a moonlit, rocky, coastal inlet with misty, midnight-blue mountains along the horizon in this shadowy, horizontal landscape painting. The sky fills the top two-thirds of the painting, and the people are small in scale against the landscape.

title: The Nun
story: The Nun, , oil on canvas. The painting depicts the upper body of a person shown from the waist up. The person is positioned slightly hunched forward, with a gentle bend at the waist, their face tilted downwards and their eyes directed down.

title: St. Dionysius
story: St. Dionysius, c. 1475/1500, oil on panel.

title: The Crucifixion
story: The Crucifixion, 19th century, oil on wood with inset brass cross. The artwork is a vertical composition depicting a scene centered around a crucifix with an embossed metallic appearance. The crucifix is positioned centrally, featuring a detailed figure of Jesus with outstretched arms.

title: Murnau
story: Murnau, 1910, oil on hardboard. The painting shows a landscape with a large, dark blue mountain in the background. Below the mountain are blocks of color, suggesting fields and structures.

title: David Anderson
story: David Anderson, 1790, oil on canvas. The artwork is a portrait showing a man from the waist up. He stands with his body turned slightly to the side, his left hand holding a hat at his side, and his right hand tucked into his waistcoat.

title: Orchard Oriole
story: Orchard Oriole, 1830/1832, pencil and oil on canvas. This is a painting of a branch with multiple birds perching on it, surrounding a round nest made of green fibers nestled amidst the leaves. The branch has green leaves and long, sharp thorns.

title: Christ among the Doctors
story: Christ among the Doctors, c. 1495/1497, oil on panel. Set in a church, nine men and one woman gather around a throne, on which sits a young boy in this vertical painting.

title: Madonna and Child with the Infant Saint John
story: Madonna and Child with the Infant Saint John, c. 1505, oil and tempera on panel. A woman and two small children, all with pale skin, sit on a rocky ledge in front of a hilly landscape in this vertical painting.

title: Still Life with Sweets and Pottery
artist: Juan van der Hamen y León
story: Still Life with Sweets and Pottery, 1627, oil on canvas. A basket of fruit, a plate of baked goods, glass jars, round wooden boxes, and terracotta-red and orange vessels are arranged among gray stone ledges set at different heights that together span the width of this horizontal still life painting. Light falls across the objects from the left, and the background is deeply shadowed, nearly black.

title: Two Women at a Window
story: Two Women at a Window, c. 1655/1660, oil on canvas. Two women with pale skin look out at us from the other side of a rectangular window opening with a shadowy interior behind them in this vertical painting.

title: Still Life with Figs and Bread
story: Still Life with Figs and Bread, c. 1770, oil on canvas. A dish of about two dozen figs, a crusty loaf of bread, a tall, black flask, and two wooden vessels are closely gathered on a wooden table or ledge in this vertical still life painting.

title: Thérèse Louise de Sureda
story: Thérèse Louise de Sureda, c. 1803/1804, oil on canvas. Shown from the knees up, a pale-skinned woman wearing a muted, sapphire-blue gown sits ramrod straight in a chair and looks at us in this vertical portrait painting.

title: The Café Singer
story: The Café Singer, 1876, oil on wood. This artwork depicts a café scene with a singer performing on a stage. The performer is a male figure standing at the center, wearing a bright red jacket, white pants, and a tall, dark hat.

title: Fantômas
story: Fantômas, 1915, oil on canvas. We look down onto a pile with a newspaper, theater program, pipe, a black and white checkerboard, and other objects painted as abstracted, geometric forms on a tabletop in this nearly square still life painting. Near the center, a rectangular form like a newspaper is painted with the headline “LE JOURNAL.” Next to it, to our left, a playbill has the name “FANTOMAS” written in black against a parakeet-green background, above black mask and a “65” in a circle below.

title: Mrs. William Hartigan
story: Mrs. William Hartigan, 1787/1796, oil on canvas. This painting shows an upper body portrait of a woman with her body slightly turned to the right and her head facing us.

title: Pierre Louis Alexandre
story: Pierre Louis Alexandre, 1879 - 1880, oil on canvas, mounted on board. This painting shows a man seated with one knee bent, his body turned to the right and his face turned slightly back toward us. He has brown skin, high cheekbones, a short, curly black beard, and short black hair.

title: Hugo Reisinger
story: Hugo Reisinger, 1907, oil on canvas. This painting shows a portrait of a middle-aged man who looks out at us. He is seated in a chair, turned slightly to the left, with his hands holding a gray hat in his lap.

title: Oedipus Cursing His Son Polynices
story: Oedipus Cursing His Son Polynices, 1786, oil on canvas. The bodies of four people are locked together through dramatic gestures and poses against a dark background in this nearly square painting. The two men have pale, peachy skin and the two women have ash-white skin, and together they almost fill the composition.

title: Swiss Landscape
story: Swiss Landscape, c. 1830, oil on paper on canvas. We look out over a patchwork of cultivated fields that slope down to our right and back to an ice-blue lake in this nearly square landscape painting.

title: The Sanctuary of Hercules
story: The Sanctuary of Hercules, 1884, oil on wood. This is a painting of four people outside of a circular stone wall that contains a statue and several trees. The four people are on the left, next to an opening in the curving wall.

title: The Wind
story: The Wind, 1910, oil on canvas. Tall trunks and the canopies trees sweep to our left in a stiff wind in this horizontal landscape painting. The bottom half of the canvas is packed solid with leafy trees.

title: Allegory of Love
story: Allegory of Love, c. 1520/1540, oil on canvas. Shown from the hips up, a nude woman stands between a table in front of her and a clothed man behind her, against a deep landscape in this vertical painting.

title: Christ at the Sea of Galilee
story: Christ at the Sea of Galilee, c. 1570s, oil on canvas. A man stands at a coastline with his back to us, gesturing toward a group of seven men sailing on the rolling sea in this horizontal painting.

title: Saint Martin and the Beggar
story: Saint Martin and the Beggar, 1600/1614, oil on canvas. A nearly nude man with peachy skin stands next to and looks up at a man with ashen, ivory-colored skin, wearing armor and riding a bright white horse in this vertical painting. The horizon line comes less than a quarter of the way up the composition, and the sky behind the men and horse is vivid, aqua blue with a few silvery-gray and pale, yellow clouds floating along the top edge of the composition.

title: Portrait of a Man
story: Portrait of a Man, first quarter 18th century, oil on canvas. The image shows a portrait of a person facing the viewer with their body slightly turned. The individual has curly, shoulder-length hair and distinct facial features including a prominent nose, slightly pursed lips, and a straight gaze.

title: Charles IV of Spain as Huntsman
story: Charles IV of Spain as Huntsman, c. 1799/1800, oil on canvas. This painting shows a man standing upright, his body slightly turned to the right.

title: The Duke of Wellington
story: The Duke of Wellington, c. 1812, oil on canvas. This painting is a portrait of a man from the waist up.

title: Chrysanthemums
story: Chrysanthemums, fourth quarter 19th century, oil on canvas. This painting shows a bouquet of large, fluffy yellow flowers with green leaves against a black background. The flowers are spread across the canvas, their long stems sitting in a yellow vase or basket.

title: Susanna Truax
story: Susanna Truax, 1730, oil on bed ticking. A pale-skinned girl wearing a striped dress and holding up a spoon and a rose looks out at us in this vertical portrait painting. Her body faces us, and her head turns lightly to the left.

title: Counsellor John Dunn
story: Counsellor John Dunn, c. 1798, oil on canvas. The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body.

title: Mrs. John Harrisson and Daughter
story: Mrs. John Harrisson and Daughter, c. 1823, oil on canvas.

title: Three Creek Indians
story: Three Creek Indians, 1861/1869, oil on card mounted on paperboard. The image depicts three individuals standing side by side outdoors. The person on the left has long dark hair tied back, wearing a pink dress and moccasins.

title: Flecks of Foam
story: Flecks of Foam, c. 1911/1912, oil on wood. The painting depicts a rocky coastline dotted with color.

title: Buried with Him by Baptism
story: Buried with Him by Baptism, c. 1765, engraving on laid paper. This is a drawing of a baptism in a river.

title: Landing of the American Forces under Genl. Scott: At Vera Cruz March 9th 1847
story: Landing of the American Forces under Genl. Scott: At Vera Cruz March 9th 1847, 1847, hand-colored lithograph on wove paper. The image shows a view from above the water, capturing troops landing on a coastline.

title: Rockbridge Alum Spring
story: Rockbridge Alum Spring, 1857, color lithograph on wove paper. The image depicts Rockbridge Alum Spring in Rockbridge County, Virginia. The viewpoint is elevated, showcasing a wide view of the area.

title: Munition Town
story: Munition Town, 1916, lithograph. The image depicts a landscape with a river winding through an industrial area. The viewpoint is elevated, showing the river and surrounding industrial buildings.

title: "Can you forgive me Father?" - "Can you forgive me daughter?"
story: "Can you forgive me Father?" - "Can you forgive me daughter?", , drypoint. This is a drawing of two figures engaged in an interaction. The drawing depicts a large seated figure with a long beard and robe, towering over a smaller standing figure who appears to be holding a baby or small child.

title: Saint Benedict and the Monk Romanus
story: Saint Benedict and the Monk Romanus, c. 1440/1450, hand-colored engraving on vellum. This is a painting of two monks and a goat-like creature in a forest.

title: Sacrifice of Isaac
story: Sacrifice of Isaac, , etching. The image shows two figures: an older man and a young boy. The man, with a long beard and possibly a bald head, is kneeling on the ground, guiding the boy who stands in front of him.

title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
story: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt, 1721, etching with roulette on laid paper. The image shows three main figures and part of a fourth being in a dynamic and illustrated setting. There is a woman with a serene expression wearing a head covering, seated or partially reclining, holding an infant child.

title: William Hayley
story: William Hayley, 1779, mezzotint. The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man with light-colored, wavy hair, wearing a double-breasted coat and a white high-collared shirt with a tied cravat. Held by the National Gallery of Art, Washington, accession 1943.3.5096.

title: A Monk with a Bagpipe Player
story: A Monk with a Bagpipe Player, 1846/49, etching on wove paper. The image displays a rocky, forested area with two figures. The viewpoint appears slightly elevated, overlooking a clearing within the trees.

title: Nude with Outstretched Arm
story: Nude with Outstretched Arm, , soft-ground etching. The image shows a full-body sketch of a standing person in a relaxed pose. The person faces away from the viewer, showing the back of their body.

title: Sorrow (Kümmernis)
story: Sorrow (Kümmernis), 1914, published 1922, drypoint in dark green on laid paper. The artwork titled "Sorrow (Kümmernis)" depicts a seated figure, shown from the waist up, with their body hunched forward and head resting on their arms, which are drawn close to the body. The figure's facial features are abstract and stylized, with expressive lines.

title: Balthasarus ab Herden Med. Doctor
story: Balthasarus ab Herden Med. Doctor, c. 1650-1665, engraving on laid paper.

title: La Dernière Maja
story: La Dernière Maja, 1880, drypoint with etching and aquatint on light blue laid paper. This is a drawing of a seated figure surrounded by abstract and fantastical elements. The central focus is a person seated with their back turned, clothed in drapery, positioned before a circular object.

title: The Bells
story: The Bells, 1905, drypoint and colored pencil on laid paper [touched proof]. The image shows a person standing upright. The individual is positioned to the side, facing slightly towards the left.

title: Hans Holbein the Younger
story: Hans Holbein the Younger, 1647, etching. The image is an illustration of a person facing slightly to the left. The individual has a prominent nose, full lips, and a beard and mustache.

title: Matthew Parker
story: Matthew Parker, 1573, etching [reprint ?]. The image shows an older man seated, visible from the waist up in a formal pose. His hands are resting on a book and writing materials on a table in front of him.

title: Man in a Great Coat
story: Man in a Great Coat, 18th century, graphite with gouache on vellum. The image depicts a man's upper body viewed from a three-quarter angle, from the chest up. He is portrayed in a slightly angled, forward-facing position with his head turned slightly to his left.

title: Baptismal Wish for Catarina Titzlir
story: Baptismal Wish for Catarina Titzlir, c. 1765, pen and brown ink and transparent and opaque watercolor on laid paper. This is a painting of a decorative folk art piece featuring two stylized figures and German script.

title: Portrait of a Girl with Blue Eyes and Blue Dress
story: Portrait of a Girl with Blue Eyes and Blue Dress, c. 1820, pastel on two sheets of paper lined wiht. The image depicts a young child sitting on a small, red upholstered stool.

title: Mountain of the Holy Cross
story: Mountain of the Holy Cross, 1890, watercolor and gouache over graphite on blue laid paper. We look across a bank of large boulders that give way to a waterfall in the middle distance, behind which a towering mountain marked with a white cross rises near the top of this vertical watercolor landscape. Painted with swirling washes of topaz and powder blue, cream white, and some touches of pale golden yellow, the central mountain ascends amid the clouds that settle around the peaks to either side.

title: The Nile—Evening
story: The Nile—Evening, 1905-1911, watercolor over graphite on wove paper. The artwork depicts an evening scene along the Nile River. The horizon is positioned high, where a group of people on camels are silhouetted against a golden sky.

title: Jael Killing Sisera
story: Jael Killing Sisera, c. 1460, pen and ink with watercolor on laid paper. The artwork is a medieval illustration depicting Jael and Sisera.

title: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence
story: The Martyrdom of Saint Lawrence, 1685, black chalk with pen and brown ink and brush and light brown wash, heightened with white gouache, on light blue laid paper. This is an illustration featuring a central figure surrounded by various other figures engaged in different actions. The main figure is depicted in a pose facing upwards, while the surrounding figures appear to be interacting with or responding to the central character.

title: Stage Design for a Domed Temple Interior with a Sun Disk above the Altar
story: Stage Design for a Domed Temple Interior with a Sun Disk above the Altar, 1780, pen and brown and gray ink with wash and watercolor over graphite on laid paper. This is a drawing of an intricately designed pavilion with columns supporting an octagonal dome. The interior features detailed ceiling panels and a central wheel-like structure.

title: Belvedere Palace, Vienna
story: Belvedere Palace, Vienna, , watercolor and chalk. The image shows an ornate building with a central dome-like roof structure. The horizon is low, and the edges of nearby rooftops are visible above eye level.

title: Self-Portrait
story: Self-Portrait, 1912, watercolor over graphite on light brown wove japan paper; partial sketch of face in graphite on verso. A man with large, dark eyes glowers at us from under black brows, one of which is lowered and the other cocked in this drawn, vertical portrait. The man’s face is angled slightly to our left, but he looks out with his red lips twisted up to our right.

title: Portrait of a Man
story: Portrait of a Man, c. 1850, daguerreotype with applied color. The image depicts a man sitting with his right arm on a stack of three books on a patterned surface.

title: Carbondale, Section 3, Del. & Hudson Canal Co.
story: Carbondale, Section 3, Del. & Hudson Canal Co., c. 1863-1865, albumen silver print.

title: William Campbell, Abingdon, Virginia
story: William Campbell, Abingdon, Virginia, c. 1930, gelatin silver print. The image shows an older man sitting, with his torso visible from the waist up.

title: Pyramids of Sakkarah & Gizeh, from above
story: Pyramids of Sakkarah & Gizeh, from above, 1880s, albumen silver print. The image shows a desert landscape with sand dunes seen from an elevated point. The terrain is covered with sand formations, some showing darker spots.

title: Portrait of a Girl
story: Portrait of a Girl, c. 1853, daguerreotype. The image shows a person standing with a slight turn to their left, their head facing forward and right hand resting on the back of a chair.

title: Le Terril
story: Le Terril, 1901, photogravure. This is a photograph of an industrial landscape with figures engaged in construction work on a mound of earth beneath a large, wooden structure. The scene is captured in black-and-white, giving it a historical or vintage feel.

title: Orléans Cathedral
story: Orléans Cathedral, June 1843, salted paper print. This is a photograph of a section of ornate architectural stonework. The image captures intricate details of gothic-style architecture, featuring arched windows adorned with complex floral carvings and geometric patterns.

title: Interior of Pehtang Fort Showing the Magazine and Wooden Gun, August 1, 1860
story: Interior of Pehtang Fort Showing the Magazine and Wooden Gun, August 1, 1860, 1860, albumen silver print. The image shows a ground-level view of a scene dominated by military and construction equipment. There are cannonballs and rope on the ground, alongside a large cannon with detailed wheels.

title: Fort Garry
story: Fort Garry, 1858, albumen silver print. The image shows a view from a slightly elevated position looking across land towards a fort or settlement enclosed by a wooden fence. The horizon line is positioned about two-thirds up from the bottom of the image, primarily showing the structures of the fort with a few buildings visible beyond the fence.

title: Portrait of a Sailor
story: Portrait of a Sailor, 1901–1904, collodion print (cabinet card). The image shows a man in a sailor's uniform with a mustache and short hair. He is facing slightly right, with his head turned towards the camera.
